notablePrerequisites:
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
Deathbringer Thoctar has at least two +1/+1 counters.
description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Urban Daggertooth.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat.
